notes.title: Hello from Jipangi Games – We Want to Become a Forest!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]This is Jipangi Games, aspiring to become a forest! [/p][p]Our name comes from the wish for roots to grow from a walking stick, eventually forming a whole forest.[/p][p][/p][p]We're currently developing Haetae: Guardians.[/p][p]It's an action game set in a Joseon fantasy world, where you embark on a journey with a cute Haetae![/p][p]We aim for classic gameplay feel with intuitive controls and various boss essence combinations.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, we're preparing the game demo (set for release on October!), and if all goes well, we'd like to evolve the next stages through playtests too![/p][p][/p][p]Up until now, we've been focused on development, so communication has been sparse, but we're committed to improving that going forward.[/p][p]We'll mainly use this Steam community, Stove, and Discord as our communication channels.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate your interest and love for Haetae: Guardians, and look forward to your support![/p][p][/p][p]Oh, before you go, don't forget to add to Wishlist, follow, and favorite...! [/p][p][/p]
